steps.what: Verify student and activity records and capture required report fields and teacher comments
Populate reports from checked records and teacher authored comments
Check reports for accuracy and relevance and approve their release to administration

tasks.design: Configure native report queries in {LMS} and fixed templates in {DOCS}. The teacher supplies any narrative comment and approves the report after checking accuracy and relevance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Records and comments were copied into recurring administration reports.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record queries and document templates can assemble checked content without inventing pupil conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Choose what the report should say and avoid misleading context.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the limits of the recorded information.
tasks.altitude: Own report quality and source traceability.

reach.learn: Distinguish missing data from poor performance

evidence.claim: ParnasSys supports pupil records and learning goal tracking; the proposed report mapping and labour effect are not a measured case.
Fixed report assembly from checked fields is E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Existing teaching and record maintenance produce underlying records; their work is unchanged and earns no saving here.

In s1 the teacher verifies and captures pupil identifiers, reporting period, required activity and mark fields, source references and exact comment text. Retrieval, missing field resolution and comments are included in 35 hours.
No developmental, diagnostic or performance flag is inferred. Missing fields return to manual reporting and checking.
Native reporting is tried first; already automatic reports have zero incremental saving.
unknowns: Current reporting features and data completeness
research_questions: Does assembly save time after comments, field capture and report verification?

already_counted.description: Field verification, comment writing and report approval

incremental.description: Report mapping upkeep and sampled source reconciliation

approvals.approved_version: Exact report, pupils, period, comments and recipient; changes invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=60 gives 40 gross and 33 net after 7 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-10 allows manual comments, missing records and existing report functions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select curriculum requirements and capture course scope, sequence constraints and available practical resources
Draft course objectives and outlines with references to the selected requirements

loop.purpose: Propose a course outline within teacher selected requirements
loop.input: Checked course planning brief and current curriculum and school requirements
loop.output: Candidate objectives and sequence with requirement references
loop.check: Teacher checks each requirement reference, practical feasibility, prerequisites and coverage without treating a reference as proof of compliance
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; absent or incorrect references return to manual planning
loop.why_not_simpler: Reuse the existing outline and fixed curriculum text first; draft only changed sequencing and explanatory wording

steps.what: Resolve curriculum gaps and establish the final objectives and course outline
outputs: teacher established course objectives and outline

tasks.design: Use existing outlines and templates in {DOCS}, then a bounded drafting step for changed sections. The teacher checks coverage and feasibility and establishes the final course design.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course outlines must connect many requirements to a workable sequence.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting tools can suggest wording and sequence for review against supplied requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Choose a sequence that fits learners and available practical resources.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a course that looks complete on paper but cannot be taught as planned.
tasks.altitude: Own course coherence and curriculum traceability.

evidence.claim: The EEF and NFER science teacher trial reported lower planning time, but it does not establish this vocational course outlining scenario.
The course outline design and savings remain an E1 task scenario.

assumptions: In s1 the teacher captures exact requirement codes and passages, course duration, prerequisites, equipment limits and intended scope. Selection, retrieval, field capture and clarification are included in 35 hours.
The drafting step never supplies a free curriculum compliance flag. A coverage map is only an aid to teacher judgement.
s2 retains 26 hours for checking and correction; s3 retains final gap resolution and course design judgement.
This task owns course level planning only. Lesson specific objectives and their student explanation belong to task 6613 and are not counted again.
Missing requirements or unsuitable sequences trigger manual outlining.
unknowns: Share of course outline requiring revision
research_questions: Does checked drafting reduce course revision effort without losing practical feasibility?

already_counted.description: Brief capture, draft checks and final course planning

incremental.description: Requirement pack upkeep and sampled mapping review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=86 gives 14 gross and 8 net after 6 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-4 allows reusable existing outlines and intensive feasibility checks; the planning trial is not used as a task coefficient.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select, store, issue and maintain equipment and capture physical inventory counts and target quantities
Calculate inventory differences and draft a replenishment list from teacher supplied targets
Check replenishment needs and approve equipment or supply orders through the school process

tasks.design: Use native inventory functions or {SPREADSHEET} totals for a replenishment suggestion, then the existing {PROCUREMENT} process for orders. Physical handling, maintenance, target selection and purchasing judgement remain with people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock counts were repeatedly compared with handwritten requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native inventory arithmetic can calculate differences from checked counts and teacher chosen targets.
tasks.still_hard: Choose suitable equipment and assess actual condition and lesson need.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise that a counted item may be unusable or unsuitable.
tasks.altitude: Manage stock quality and justified purchases.

reach.learn: Distinguish usable quantities from physical presence

evidence.claim: A checked count and target table can produce replenishment arithmetic without a model; this classroom scenario is E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: In s1 the teacher counts and captures item identifier, unit, usable stock quantity, count date and teacher chosen target quantity. Physical inspection, target selection, capture and corrections are included in 55 hours.
No par level, usable stock flag or maintenance status is supplied free of work. Missing counts or unclear units return to manual comparison and decision in s3.
The supplier provides current offer details before ordering; s3 includes obtaining and checking item, quantity, price and delivery details. No automated purchase is made.
Native inventory functionality is checked first; existing automation yields zero additional saving.
unknowns: Current inventory support and share of manual comparison
research_questions: Does a target comparison save time after usable stock counting and purchasing checks?

already_counted.description: Physical handling, inventory capture, target choice and ordering

incremental.description: Inventory table upkeep and sampled reconciliation
School inventory and purchasing system support

approvals.approved_version: Exact request or order, items, quantities, prices and destination; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=80 gives 20 gross and 13 net after 7 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-3 reflects dominant physical work and possible existing inventory functions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collaborate with teachers and administrators to develop, evaluate and revise middle school programs

tasks.design: Retain program collaboration as professional discussion and joint judgement. A meeting summary is not credited with replacing the development and evaluation work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program changes require shared understanding and agreement among colleagues.
tasks.enabler_now: No supplied evidence establishes replacement of that collaborative judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Reconcile different classroom experience and priorities.
tasks.human_edge: Understand colleagues' constraints and negotiate a workable change.
tasks.altitude: Improve the quality of joint program decisions.

reach.learn: Draw out practical constraints and test alternatives

evidence.claim: Professional program collaboration remains human work; no task labour saving is established.

assumptions: Program evaluation and agreement are produced during s1; no ready made consensus or program suitability flag is assumed.
Separate course preparation and reporting tasks own their respective savings; no meeting paperwork baseline is invented here.
No new deployment or operating work means upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Program review scope and decision arrangements
research_questions: Which unresolved differences most delay program revisions?

already_counted.description: Joint development, evaluation and revision discussion

incremental.description: No added software or operating process

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: professional collaboration remains fully counted, with zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Improve report and inventory traceability while retaining practical teaching and curriculum judgement.
reach: Help colleagues check course coverage and distinguish usable classroom stock
role.ambitious_version: A teacher with less report copying and stock comparison and preserved time for thoughtful course design and collaboration.
